reason: Lab run on branch test/broker-parity-84 (PR #110) inside a disposable, network-disconnected VM cloned from the read-only golden image (Windows Server 2025), driven by test/windows-service-lab/lab-vm.ps1. Real services under virtual accounts with restricted service SIDs. Guest rollback: 4 services deleted, lab root removed, no unexpected delta; the VM was deleted afterwards. Machine-specific S-1-5-21 SIDs are redacted.
findings: The four issue #84 checks pass under the real service identity: m1 (configured generation advances the journal and revokes the older generation; a lower one ends the start with 1066 / 76), m2 (a version 2 journal is migrated to version 3 before RUNNING), m3 (inspect returns the recorded state and leaves the journal files byte-identical), m4 (after restoring a backup of the stopped service, receipts fenced before or claimed after the backup are refused because the start wipes all challenges; a fresh fence and claim work).
e_session0 stays BLOCKED as in earlier runs. Clock rollback is host-tested only (its offset is a test seam not present in shipped builds).

journal claims=1 (expected 1: only the fresh claim; the claim made after the backup was lost with the restore)
